title: The NEXT Frontier: THESE 3 Stocks Boom
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: AI is speeding up drug and therapy development (personalized cancer vaccines, engineered phages), making healthcare the next AI frontier.

calls.condition: Binary on the Oct 24 phase 3 melanoma data presentation: good report could make it a $300 stock, bad report sends it back to ~$140.
calls.reason: Owns it (bought 135-145); AI shortens personalized cancer therapy design; optimistic about the Saturday phase 3 presentation; notes Bank of America target of 220.
calls.quote: I personally am exposed to Moderna stock. I'm very excited about it.

calls.reason: Calls Eli Lilly the 'S&P 500 of healthcare AI': an acquisition machine with ~1.9 PEG and reasonable valuation; lowest-risk healthcare AI play.
calls.quote: this I think is the lowest risk play, and I still think their valuation is reasonable despite the fact that they've done very well already.

calls.reason: AI data/apps segment growing 28% with better margins, but not profitable until 2028 and last-quarter profit came from stock gains; too early to call winner, so he doesn't own it.
calls.quote: However, I don't invest in them. I still think it's it's potentially a little early

notes: Recorded the week of the Oct 24 (Saturday) Moderna presentation; no explicit date stated. Kevin says he has exposure to two of the three stocks; inferred MRNA and LLY. MRNA entry is midpoint of stated 135-145 buy zone.
